capabilities: Host and join real-time editing sessions with live cursors
Sync file creates, deletes, renames, and binary files between participants
Set guest permissions, approvals, and host transfer
Follow, summon, and present navigation to participants
Encrypt shared content end-to-end with AES-256-GCM
disambiguation: Not a publishing tool or personal device sync; it hosts live co-editing sessions where the host's vault is the source of truth.
extras: Requires running a relay server (included, self-hostable) at a URL you configure; full threat model is in a separate docs/security.md; binary files up to 50 MB; without GitHub OAuth an anonymous local ID is used.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for multiple people to edit the same vault together in real time.

relations.evidence: Or install via BRAT for automatic updates.

summary: Real-time collaborative editing plugin that shares vault files over a self-hostable relay server with live cursors, presence, and end-to-end encryption.
